label: dam-probe-p1
_why: ENGINE PROBE of the hydro-dam megaprojects (ROADMAP step 6, BALANCE_FRAMEWORK §10.90, user-ruled 2026-09-26: 'Go on with the tests. Full 100 years n=1 after all the probes you need'). ARM = config/mod_config.canon-dams-probe.json {kind: config}: the canon (canon-b164-trade) + building_required_construction {building_power_plant: 1600} + dams {enabled, the first-pass 158-project table with placeholder anchor provinces} + dams.probe {the three class technologies granted at the start to GBR FRA USA RUS PRU AUS SWE SAR SWI TUR; surveys 2 months; stage cost x0.05}. The probe settings exist ONLY to make the mechanism fire inside three years; nothing economic is read from this run.

_questions.Q1: Do the survey decisions appear for the anchor owner AND its overlords (GBR for British India's states, TUR for Egypt) and does the AI take them?
_questions.Q2: Does the survey journal entry count months, complete, and set the global variable (PMR_DAM|survey_complete lines)?
_questions.Q3: Does the AI government construct the unique stage buildings (in the yearly save summaries: building_dam_* in queues, then in buildings), including an overlord building in a subject's state?
_questions.Q4: Do the stages produce electricity and hire (save summaries: goods_out electricity, staffing), with no private-queue dam construction?
_questions.Q5: Do on_building_built effects fire (PMR_DAM|built / complete lines; the arable-land and trait effects where a project with effects completes), and did the start traits land on Middle/Upper Egypt and Blue Nile?
_questions.Q6: error.log: no errors naming zzz_pm_rehaul_dams / bg_pmr_hydro_dams / the stripped trait files; no missing-entity or locator errors from the unique buildings; the power plant costs 1600.

_predictions.Q1: Surveys start within the first year in several granted countries; GBR surveys at least one Indian project.
_predictions.Q2: survey_complete lines 2-4 months after each survey_start.
_predictions.Q3: Stage buildings appear in government queues and some complete by 1838-39 (~170-500 points at ~20-25 points/week).
_predictions.Q4: Yes; no dam in any private queue.
_predictions.Q5: PMR_DAM|start line at 1836.1.1; built lines for completed stages.
_predictions.Q6: Clean, or errors that name exactly what to fix.

_cost: 1 run x 1836.1.1 -> 1839.1.1, about 5 minutes of play plus the build and load.
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
Probe build: techs granted, costs and surveys shrunk - do not read any economic number from it.
